_: Gate thresholds of docs/plans/2026-11-17-instant-edit-design.md section 4.3. A null threshold = report only. kind=time checks are only valid at load <= loadGate; kind=structural counts are not. level=cell judges every cell (cells: all | deepest | shallowest), level=fixture judges the fit over all cells. A threshold map names the fixtures it gates (page size: owner 54 KB, bigpage 34 KB, big 1.4 KB); any other fixture is reported only.
